response.overview: A Document and a Legacy  In 1971, in the middle of the dictatorship, director Kostas Hronopoulos secretly filmed the junta's propaganda festivities at the Panathenaic Stadium (Kallimarmaro) and smuggled the footage out of the country. The result was the documentary with the sarcastic title "Greece of Christian Greeks." It offers a comprehensive picture of life in Greece at the time and a sharp critique of the regime.
response.title: Ελλάς Ελλήνων Χριστιανών
